newsitem.title: USA: Goahed for new JFK Northwest cargo complex.
newsitem.headline: Goahed for new JFK Northwest cargo complex.

text.p: Northwest Airlines Inc will build a $31 million air cargo complex at Kennedy Airport under a lease agreement authorized on Wednesday, the New York and New Jersey Port Authority said.

The agreement extends Northwest's current lease from 1999 to 2015. Under the agreement the airline will also demolish its existing air cargo facilities at Hangars 1 and 2 and build an 85,000 square-foot complex in its place.
The construction of Northwest's new facility will be built on only 12 of the 22 acres it currently occupies at the airport.
The Port Authority said it will look to attract other air cargo tenants to the remaining 10 acres. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +5017
